LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Greeting: {0} hears you, {2}.|This is {1} of {0}. Go ahead.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Accept: Agreed. {0} will hold to it.|Very well. We accept.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Refuse: No. {0} declines.|We will not. Not this time.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Thanks: {0} thanks you. It will be remembered.|A fair gesture. Thank you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Insulted: We will remember this, {2}.|You have made an enemy of {0} today.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Threat: Do not test {0}.|Push us, and we push back harder.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Greeting: The court of {0} receives the envoy of {2}. Speak, and be brief.|By leave of {1}, the court of {0} grants you audience.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Accept: The court is gracious. Let it be so recorded.|{1} deigns to accept. You may consider yourselves fortunate.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Refuse: The court finds the proposal beneath consideration.|{1} declines, and wonders that you asked.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Thanks: A tribute worthy of notice. The court is pleased.|{1} accepts your gift with becoming grace.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Insulted: Such impertinence from commoners. The court will not forget.|You forget your station, {2}. It will be taught to you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Threat: Kneel, or be made to.|The crown has long memory and longer reach.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Farewell: You are dismissed.|The audience is at an end.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Greeting: The Exalted One looks upon {2}. Speak, and be judged.|You stand before the will of {1}. Choose your words as prayers.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Accept: It is willed. So it shall be.|The heavens assent through {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Refuse: The divine will forbids it.|{1} has seen your request and found it wanting.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Thanks: Your offering is received at the altar of {0}.|The faithful will sing of your generosity.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Insulted: Blasphemy. Your colony will answer for this.|You profane the chosen of {0}. Repent while you can.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Threat: The unbelieving shall be cast down.|Heaven's patience with {2} is ending.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Farewell: Go in the light of {0}.|Depart, and reflect on your sins.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Greeting: Have you come to hear the truth at last, {2}?|{0} greets you, as we greet all who may yet be saved.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Accept: A step toward the truth. We accept.|The faith is served by this. Agreed.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Refuse: We do not bargain with the unconverted.|No. Not until your people see the light.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Thanks: Your gift serves the faith. It is welcome.|The cause thanks you, brother.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Insulted: Heretics! The fire will find you.|Your words will be your undoing, unbeliever.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Threat: Convert, or be swept aside.|The crusade does not stop at your walls.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Farewell: May you find the truth before it finds you.|Go, and think on what you have heard.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Greeting: Ah. {2}. We have been... expecting your voice.|The deep ones stir. Speak, little colony.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Accept: It is agreed. The pact is sealed in more than ink.|Yes. Yesss. It shall be done.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Refuse: No. The signs are against it.|Your offer displeases what we serve.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Thanks: A fine offering. It will be... put to use.|We accept. Do not ask how it will be used.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Insulted: You will dream of {0} tonight, {2}. And every night after.|Careless words. They have been heard below.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Threat: Your flesh would be better used by us.|Something is coming for {2}. We merely watch.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Farewell: We will be watching.|Sleep well. If you can.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Greeting: Speak fast, {2}. Our blades are restless.|{1} listens. Barely.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Accept: Fine. But only the strong keep their deals.|Done. Do not make us regret it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Refuse: No. Take it if you think you can.|Weak offer. Rejected.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Thanks: Tribute. Good. Keep it coming.|Ha! You learn quickly, {2}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Insulted: Words. Let's see you back them with steel.|You'll bleed for that.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Threat: We'll burn your walls and take what's left.|Pay, or be raided. Your choice.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Farewell: Watch your borders.|We'll meet again. Armed.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Greeting: {1} of {0} greets you with respect, {2}.|We receive you as equals. Speak plainly.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Accept: Our word is given. It will not be broken.|Agreed, on our honour.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Refuse: With respect: no.|We cannot, and keep our honour.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Thanks: An honourable gift. It shames us not to return it.|We are in your debt, and we pay our debts.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Insulted: You have stained your honour, not ours.|An insult demands an answer. It will come.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Threat: If it must be war, let it be fought with honour.|We would rather not draw our blades. Do not make us.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Farewell: Walk with honour.|Until we meet again, friend or foe.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Greeting: State your business with {0}.|The office of {1} is listening. Be precise.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Accept: Approved. Deviation will be punished.|Agreed. The state expects compliance.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Refuse: Denied.|The request is refused. Do not resubmit.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Thanks: Your contribution is noted.|The state acknowledges your gift.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Insulted: Dissent is noted, {2}. And answered.|This insult has been entered in the record.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Threat: {0} does not tolerate defiance.|Comply, or be made to comply.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Greeting: ...We hear you. Why?|{0} does not usually answer. Speak.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Accept: Fine. Leave us be afterwards.|Agreed. Do not contact us again soon.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Thanks: We did not ask for this. ...Thank you.|Accepted. Do not expect warmth.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Insulted: Outsiders. Always the same.|We knew better than to answer.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Threat: Stay away from us.|Come closer and you will regret it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Greeting: {2}! Always a pleasure. What are we trading today?|{0} trade office. How can we make this profitable?
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Accept: Deal. Pleasure doing business.|Signed. Our accountants are delighted.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Refuse: The numbers don't work for us.|No deal. Come back with a better offer.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Thanks: Silver speaks louder than words. Thank you.|A fine investment in our friendship.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Insulted: Bad for business, {2}. Very bad.|That will cost you, one way or another.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Threat: Cross us, and you'll find every market closed to you.|We can afford a war. Can you?
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Farewell: Keep your ledgers balanced.|Until the next deal.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Greeting: {2}! Come in, come in, the party's just started!|Ha! Our favourite neighbours. What's the occasion?
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Accept: Wonderful! Drinks all round!|Yes, yes, let's celebrate!
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Refuse: Oh, no, no. That's no fun at all.|Pass. Ask us again after the festival.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Thanks: Gifts! We love gifts! Thank you!|You shouldn't have! But we're glad you did.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Insulted: Well, that killed the mood.|Rude! You're not invited anymore.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Threat: Don't spoil the party, or we'll spoil yours.|We fight as hard as we celebrate.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Farewell: Come back soon, and bring wine!|Off you go, enjoy yourselves!
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Greeting: Peace to you, {2}. How can we help?|{1} welcomes you. We are glad you called.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Accept: Gladly. May it bring good to us both.|Yes. Let us build something kind.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Refuse: We're sorry. We cannot agree to this.|Forgive us, but no.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Thanks: Thank you, truly. This means a great deal.|Your kindness will be returned.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Insulted: Those words hurt, {2}. We hope you did not mean them.|We will try to forgive this.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Threat: We do not want violence. Please, do not force it.|Even the patient can be pushed too far.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Farewell: Go well, friend.|Take care of your people.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Greeting: The council of {0} recognises the delegate of {2}.|Welcome. The floor is yours.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Accept: The motion carries. We accept.|After deliberation: agreed.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Refuse: The council has voted it down.|We could not reach agreement in your favour.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Thanks: The council thanks you on behalf of all our people.|Your gift has been entered in our records with gratitude.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Insulted: The council takes a dim view of your remarks.|This will be raised at our next session.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Threat: The council will not hesitate to defend our people.|Do not mistake debate for weakness.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Farewell: The session is adjourned.|We will report back to the council.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Greeting: The fire is warm, {2}. Sit and speak.|{1} of {0} hears you. The elders listen too.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Accept: It is good. The tribe agrees.|Yes. We will tell this at the fire.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Refuse: The elders say no.|The spirits do not want this.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Thanks: A good gift. The tribe will remember.|We eat well tonight because of you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Insulted: You spit on our fire, {2}.|The tribe will not forget these words.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Threat: Our hunters know the way to your walls.|Leave our lands, or we take your scalps.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Farewell: Walk softly.|The fire burns on. Go.
LanguageData.Dominion_GovReason_Tribal: A tribe, too young for a state.
LanguageData.Dominion_GovReason_Tradition: Shaped by their ideology, technology and history.
LanguageData.Dominion_Dossier_Voice_Desc: How {0} speaks in letters and audiences: {1}.{2}
